title: KCC GenSan Marathon 2026 Review: A Single-Distance 42K in Manny Pacquiao's Hometown
seo_title: KCC GenSan Marathon 2026 Review | General Santos Philippines
meta_description: The KCC GenSan Marathon 2026: November 14 at Veranza Mall, General Santos City. A single-distance full marathon (42.195K) in the Philippines' Tuna Capital.
dek: Set for 14 November 2026 at Veranza Mall in General Santos City — the 'Tuna Capital' of the Philippines and Manny Pacquiao's hometown — this is a single-distance full marathon. Registration isn't open yet.
verdict: The KCC GenSan Marathon is a single-distance full marathon in General Santos City — Mindanao's southern hub, best known as the tuna capital of the Philippines and the hometown of boxing legend Manny Pacquiao. A standalone 42K, with no companion distances, makes it a focused proposition for serious marathoners. Registration isn't open yet and the reliability score is low, so it's one to track rather than book. The November date in GenSan is relatively dry, with manageable temperatures.

sections.heading: General Santos: Tuna Capital
paragraphs: GenSan is a major city in southern Mindanao, known for its tuna industry, its boxing heritage, and Mount Matutum on the horizon. [1] Veranza Mall provides a convenient race hub with parking and facilities. November is the onset of the relatively drier period in this part of Mindanao.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: A focused single-distance marathon in an under-represented Philippine city. Track for registration updates. 14 November 2026 at Veranza Mall, General Santos City. [1]
